title: comarostaphylis formosa
intro: Comarostaphylis formosa, commonly known as the Taiwan sweet olive or Chinese boxwood, is a plant species native to Taiwan. It is a small, evergreen tree or shrub that has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The health benefits of Comarostaphylis formosa include its ability to aid in the treatment of fever, cough, and digestive issues, while its therapeutic actions include acting as an expectorant and anti-inflammatory agent. The bioactive constituents of Comarostaphylis formosa include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
